summary: Send private money as a link to anyone without requiring prior registration.

name: Quietline
one_liner: Encrypted on-chain mail on Starknet. Payment memos ride the same private transfer.
readme_hash:
7372:# Quietline

Encrypted on-chain mail on Starknet.

Addresses never appear on the message. Content decrypts only on the
recipient's device. A private transfer can carry a memo in the same
transaction —
summary: Send encrypted on-chain messages with optional payment memos.
description_long: This project allows users to send encrypted messages on Starknet without revealing sender or recipient identities. It uses a privacy invoke helper to ensure messages are decrypted only on the recipient's device and can optionally include a payment memo in a single transaction, addressing the challenge of private communication on public blockchains.
latest_push: Migrated the client to Vite SPA and documented the deployment process.

5826:# Veilcast

Private prediction markets on Starknet. Visible odds, invisible bettors.

> Built for the STRK20 Private Sprint. Runs against the live STRK20 privacy pool on Starknet.

## What it is

Veil
summary: Create anonymous prediction markets on Starknet with visible odds.
description_long: Veilcast allows users to place bets on prediction markets while keeping their identities anonymous. It leverages the STRK20 privacy pool to ensure bet amounts are public for accurate pricing, but anonymizes the bettor's identity and links between bets to prevent tracking and manipulation. The use of Cairo contracts and integrated oracles ensures transparent market operations while maintaining privacy.
latest_push: Added private prediction market scaffold and design using STRK20 starter kit.

name: stk402
readme_hash:
8086:# stk402

Private STRK20 payments for x402 agents on Starknet.

STK402 adds an `exact-private` x402 payment scheme. An agent pays with a private STRK20 transfer. The server verifies the signed receipt
summary: Implement private STRK20 payments for x402 agents on Starknet.
description_long: This project creates an `exact-private` payment scheme for x402 agents using private STRK20 transfers. It involves the verification of signed receipts and prevention of replay attacks while ensuring secure resource retrieval after payment. The system operates within a Devnet environment and includes planned future functions for Sepolia and Mainnet operations.
latest_push: Added safe private balance funding and client for payments.

**Negotiate in darkness, settle in silence.**

Erebus is experimental coordination and shielded-settlement infrastructure for AI agents.

[Open the public demo](https://erebus-private-agents
summary: Provide infrastructure for autonomous AI agent negotiations and settlements.
description_long: The project enables AI agents to negotiate and settle transactions securely through encrypted channels, ensuring that the negotiation process remains private. It aims to solve the issue of transparency in agent-to-agent commerce by providing atomic settlements and controlled disclosure of transaction details, preventing unauthorized observers from gleaning insights from metadata alone.
